summary: Completed backend-only regression for Internal Data AI Water/Waste fixes using live API plus deterministic formatter unit test. Verified all requested scenarios: water approved count response, Waste->Spills routing for oct/october 2026, spillage amount using Volume of spill=4200 with no inferred unit, retrieval-error formatting as STATUS_UNAVAILABLE (not NOT_FOUND), and restricted-user authorization boundaries.
critical_code_review_comments: response_builder.py creates OpenAI client at import time, which hard-fails unit-test collection when OPENAI_API_KEY is absent. Consider lazy client initialization or dependency injection for safer testability.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only validation against existing data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression assertions confirmed live outputs: water approved query returns Records found=45 and Approved=1 without NOT_FOUND; oct/october spill approval routes to Environment -> Waste -> Spills with approved record; spillage amount returns Volume of spill 4200 with unit not stored. Restricted user output remained facility-scoped (Facility E/Organization level only).
rca of the issue: Validated fixed RCA path: metric_resolver now uses organization_id correctly for config resolution; executor retrieval errors no longer surface as false NOT_FOUND because formatter handles error payload via STATUS_UNAVAILABLE response; waste spill/spillage phrasing now routes deterministically to Waste->Spills and picks configured Volume of spill field for amount questions.
